## Headline

**Dr Stephen J Newhouse, PhD** — Head of Professional Services & Senior Bioinformatician at **[Biorelate Ltd.](https://www.biorelate.com)**.

20+ years across **academia, NHS, and industry** — bioinformatics, ML, target/drug/biomarker discovery, knowledge graphs, agentic AI.

📍 Manchester, England, UK — open to hybrid / remote.

[LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/sjnewhouse/) · [GitHub](https://github.com/snewhouse) · [Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/sjnewhouse) · [ORCID](https://orcid.org/0000-0002-1843-9842) · [Google Scholar](https://scholar.google.co.uk/citations?user=NPnNtkMAAAAJ) · [KCL Pure](https://kclpure.kcl.ac.uk/portal/stephen.newhouse.html)

## Top skills

**Top 3 (LinkedIn):** Agile Methodologies · Data Management · Natural Language Processing (NLP)

- **Languages:** Python, R, Bash, SQL
- **ML / data:** scikit-learn, PyCaret, Prophet, MLflow, pandas, NumPy, Streamlit, classical stats, time-series, biostats
- **NLP & knowledge graphs:** biomedical text mining, entity & relation extraction, graph-based reasoning
- **LLM / agentic AI:** RAG, agent memory, tool-use, evaluation, MCP, Anthropic / OpenAI / HuggingFace stacks
- **Bioinformatics:** NGS (DNA/RNA), variant calling, GWAS, RNA-seq, multi-omics, drug repurposing, Illumina arrays
- **Pipelines & infra:** Snakemake, Nextflow, Docker, Conda; Git/GitHub; CI/CD
- **Cloud:** AWS, GCP
- **Leadership:** team building, client engagement, training, consulting, cross-functional delivery, Agile

## Experience

### Head of Professional Services & Senior Bioinformatician · [Biorelate Ltd.](https://www.biorelate.com)
**June 2021 – present** · United Kingdom (Manchester)

- Lead a high-performing Professional Services team delivering exceptional client value, fostering long-term partnerships, and driving company growth.
- Spearhead client onboarding, training, and product trials — ensuring seamless adoption and maximising the impact of Biorelate's solutions.
- Oversee bespoke projects and consultancy engagements, leveraging industry expertise and cutting-edge data to address unique client challenges.
- Active contributor to sales / business-development success.
- Champion cross-functional collaboration with Sales, Business Development, Marketing, Product, and Data Science.
- Act as an internal client to Product, providing feedback and insights so solutions remain at the forefront of quality and relevance.

**Selected achievements**

- Built and led a successful Professional Services team with a client-centric culture and consistently high client satisfaction.
- Played a pivotal role in driving revenue growth — contributing to **over £1 M in annual sales**.
- Established strong cross-functional partnerships across the organisation.
- Delivered consistently high-quality client engagements, exceeding expectations and building lasting relationships.

### Data Scientist · Grid Edge
**January 2021 – June 2021** · United Kingdom

- Worked closely with the data-science team to define and deliver ML products and enhancements on time, on budget, on spec.
- Developed advanced ML models for prediction of complex multivariate time-series, allowing faster times-to-prediction for clients with limited data.
- **Key achievement:** built an EDA + ML web application using Streamlit, Python, pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, PyCaret, Prophet, MLflow, and Docker — letting data scientists explore, clean, process, and track data for ML experiments on complex multivariate time-series.

### King's College London  ·  *(8 years total, 2011 – 2019)*

#### Bioinformatics Module Lead, Genomic Medicine MSc
**November 2015 – August 2019** — KCL & SGUL

Module lead: organised and coordinated an intensive week of lectures and hands-on practicals covering bioinformatics applied to Genomic Medicine and the [100,000 Genomes Project](https://www.genomicsengland.co.uk/).
Course material: [snewhouse/Genomic-Medicine-MSc-Bioinformatics](https://github.com/snewhouse/Genomic-Medicine-MSc-Bioinformatics/tree/master/kcl-Feb-2016).

#### Data Science Group Lead — Department of Biostatistics & Health Informatics
**November 2015 – August 2019** · London, UK

- Member of the Bioinformatics & IT Committee for the **South London Genomic Medicine Centre**.
- Managed a sub-team focused on genomic and transcriptomic work applied to neurodegenerative and psychiatric disorders.
- Developed and implemented bioinformatic / analytical pipelines for genomic and transcriptomic data analysis.
- Built pipelines for **drug repurposing** using public and private genomic and transcriptomic data.
- Led a small Core Bioinformatics service for **Illumina SNP and Expression Array** processing — raw → analysis-ready data.
- Consulted on NGS pipelines for local NHS Genetics Labs and research groups.
- Consulted on data science: biostatistics, statistical genetics, ML, applied predictive modelling, EDA, analytics.
- Co-supervised PhD students (academic and pastoral support); presented at internal and external meetings.
- Teaching: NHS & academic staff and students (BSc, MSc, PhD, working professionals).
